title: Necromancy School
html:
This page is about the Wizard subclass. For a list of all spells of this school, see Necromancy.

Necromancy School is one of the subclasses of Wizard. These Wizards are specialized in powers of death, allowing them to protect themselves from harm and raise undead minions to serve them.

“
You walk through the valley of the shadow of death, and make lots of friends there.
„

Subclass features

This subclass obtains all the features from its base class, Wizard, in addition to its unique features outlined below.

Level 2

Necromancy Savant
Halves the cost to learn Necromancy spells from Scrolls. Learning these spells will only cost  25 gp per spell level.
Grim Harvest
Once per turn, if you kill a creature with a spell, you regain Hit Points equal to twice the Spell Slot level used - thrice if it's a Necromancy spell. Undead and Constructs are unaffected.

Level 6

Undead Thralls: Animate Dead
You gain the  Animate Dead spell, if you didn't have it already
Undead Thralls: Additional Undead
When you use  Animate Dead, you can raise an additional corpse.
Undead Thralls: Better Summons
Creatures created with  Animate Dead have additional hit points equal to your wizard level, and your Proficiency Bonus is added to their damage.

Level 10

Inured to Undeath
You have steeped yourself so completely in death that you are Resistant to Necrotic damage, and moreover your hit point maximum cannot be reduced.
